text: Illustrate the story here: Pete's Pet Snake Pete got a pet snake. Pete gave the snake a name. "You are Steve," Pete said to the snake. Steve has a huge glass cage. Pete has to lock the cage, so Steve is safe. Steve likes his cage. He can hide next to the rocks. He can rest in the sunshine or the shade. At his age, Steve's skin sheds and his scales change. This looks a bit strange, but Pete likes Steve all the same.
